data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

## What
Create docs/contracts/dso-story-merge-trailer.md documenting the DSO-Story-Merge trailer schema emitted by merge-story-branch.sh (local mode) and consumed by the S5 provenance verifier.

## Required content (all fields must be documented):
- **Trailer name**: DSO-Story-Merge
- **Value format**: <story-id> (raw ticket ID, e.g., 2abb-11b6-37ca-49dc; no whitespace, no prefix)
- **Line position**: Last line of git commit message body (after a blank line separator following the subject line, per git-trailer convention)
- **Emitter**: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-story-branch.sh (local mode); ci-pr mode uses GitHub PR provenance signals instead
- **Consumer**: S5 provenance verifier (story a020-f33c-389c-449d) — reads the trailer to cross-check that the merge commit on the session branch maps to a provenanced sub-branch PR
- **Distinguished from**: DSO-Story: trailer written by apply-attribution-trailers.sh on task commits (not merge commits); the two trailers are orthogonal
- **Contract test reference**: tests/scripts/test-merge-story-branch.sh (tests 3 + 4 from T3 RED task verify the contract file exists and documents required fields)

## Example commit message (include verbatim in the contract file):
```
Merge story/d076-d35e-55db-4843/2abb-11b6-37ca-49dc

DSO-Story-Merge: 2abb-11b6-37ca-49dc
```

## File impact
- docs/contracts/dso-story-merge-trailer.md (new file)

## Acceptance
Tests 3 and 4 from task T3 pass GREEN after this file is created.
